integrity.mathematics: Full analytical proof supplied, with independent finite consistency tests.
integrity.provenance: No claim of external verification or independent certification.
integrity.scope: One all-dimensional spectral and extremizer theorem, with sharp gap and explicit limits.

scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to exact degree two, coordinate orthants, and probability-normalized spherical measure.
It does not determine higher-degree or general spherical-polyhedral concentration spectra.
The 2016/2017 Slepian patch-matrix framework already includes the three-dimensional octant as an implicit numerical eigenproblem.
Bibliographic originality is best-knowledge, not independently certified; an older equivalent formula may exist.
title: Exact degree-two Slepian spectrum on spherical orthants
